title: Refused completion keeps its slot through the gateway
description: Use a disposable gateway, run ledger, project and slots to verify that a run refused at COMPLETE keeps its slot: bound release, recycle, a later-step replay and a find-slot replay are refused, a failed replay from the refused step restores the claim, and only the named force discard releases it before archive. A failed run that still holds its slot releases it when replayed from find-slot. No operator runs or slots are used.

retained-completion.intent: A refused completion's checkout survives worker release, recycle and retries until the named discard, and a fresh slot selection never leaves the old slot held.
